title: Physical proximity IS authentication. USB hub travels. HSMs accumulate at home.

the_vision.principle: Touch ONCE = trust FOREVER. Single proximity starts the reveal.
the_vision.how: Kevin carries SoloKey + Pixel + iPhone. Each gate gets physically touched. Over time ALL gates have been enrolled by ALL devices.
the_vision.endgame: ANY registered device approaching from a distance begins the reveal. The HSMs at home verify. No cloud. No password. Presence IS proof.

usb_hub_protocol.what: USB hub with ADB cables travels between gates
steps: 3. Run enrollment ceremony (beardog key generate per device)
4. Gate stores device fingerprints in local HSM / beardog keyring
5. Unplug hub, move to next gate
6. Repeat until ALL gates know ALL devices
usb_hub_protocol.result: Every gate has enrolled every portable device. Trust web is COMPLETE.
usb_hub_protocol.can_disable_locks_after: Once all gates are enrolled, no more manual ceremony needed
